variants.headline: People leave the colony on the ship
variants.body: People have left the colony on the ship: young adults without work and families without homes. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Departure follows a lack of work and homes
variants.body: The ship has taken away young adults with no work and families with no home. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A ship takes settlers away
variants.body: Young adults lacking work and families lacking homes have departed the colony aboard the ship. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
